# custom-apis commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `add-parameter` | Add a request parameter or response property to a Custom API |
| `get` | Get details for a specific Custom API |
| `list` | List registered Custom APIs in the environment |
| `register` | Register a new Custom API in Dataverse |
| `remove-parameter` | Remove a request parameter or response property from a Custom API |
| `set-plugin` | Set or clear the implementing plugin type on a Custom API |
| `unregister` | Unregister a Custom API from Dataverse |
| `update` | Update an existing Custom API |
| `update-parameter` | Update display name or description of a Custom API parameter |
